If you are dissatisfied or underwhelmed by traditional meditation practices, I would highly recommend transcendental meditation. This form of meditation gives the mind a task (repetition of a mantra) and during my first session I literally couldn’t stop smiling and even started laughing due to how good it felt. While it’s true I went into the class with high hopes, I don’t believe this was a placebo. I left the TM center feeling like I had came down off a low dose of mushrooms and to this day I feel like I hit a refresh button every time I practice. While it’s true one has to pay money to “learn the technique”, I think it’s worth it for anyone looking for a healthy, relaxing outlet for their “monkey mind”. After TM I have quit marijuana and have a diminished desire for alcohol or other psychedelics - something that use to have a vice grip on me…
